# 5-Day Lisbon Trip Plan for 2 Adults

A relaxed Lisbon plan with historic neighborhoods, seafood, and one easy day trip, designed to fit **€1,800 total excluding flights**. Costs below are estimates for **2 adults** and assume comfortable mid-range choices.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary

### Day 1: Baixa, Chiado, and Alfama Arrival Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and keep it light with a café breakfast in **Baixa**.
- Afternoon: Stroll **Rua Augusta**, **Rossio**, and **Chiado**; ride or walk up into **Alfama** for viewpoints.
- Dinner: Seafood dinner in Alfama or near the river; choose grilled fish or arroz de marisco.
- Transit: Use the **airport metro** or taxi to the hotel; then walk most of the day.
- Estimated cost: **€220–€280** total
  - Hotel: €140–€200
  - Food/drinks: €60–€80
  - Local transit: €10–€20

### Day 2: Belém, Riverside Sights, and Classic Pastries
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Head to **Belém** for **Jerónimos Monastery** and the riverside promenade.
- Afternoon: Visit **Belém Tower** or the **Monument to the Discoveries**, then slow down with a pastel de nata stop.
- Dinner: Return to central Lisbon for a seafood-focused dinner in Cais do Sodré or Santos.
- Transit: Take **tram, bus, or rideshare** to Belém; use the same return method after sunset.
- Estimated cost: **€230–€300** total
  - Hotel: €140–€200
  - Food/drinks: €70–€90
  - Entry/transit: €20–€30

### Day 3: Day Trip to Sintra
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/train-front.svg
- Morning: Take an early **train from Rossio to Sintra** and start with **Pena Palace** or **Quinta da Regaleira**.
- Afternoon: Explore Sintra’s old town, then choose one main scenic site rather than rushing multiple castles.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/4c/Lisbon_%281600%29_detail_1.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Explore Sintra’s old town, then choose one main scenic site rather than rushing multiple castles, Lisbon, Portugal
- Dinner: Back in Lisbon, keep it easy with a late seafood dinner near your hotel.
- Transit: **Train to Sintra**, then **local bus or taxi** for hilltop sights; return by train in the evening.
- Estimated cost: **€260–€340** total
  - Hotel: €140–€200
  - Food/drinks: €70–€90
  - Train/entry/local transit: €50–€70

### Day 4: Mouraria, Graça, and Sunset Viewpoints
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/sun.svg
- Morning: Start in **Mouraria** for a quieter historic walk and local coffee.
- Afternoon: Explore **Graça** and the surrounding viewpoints at an unhurried pace.
- Dinner: Book a seafood spot with a simple menu and enjoy a long dinner.
- Transit: Mostly **walks with short tram or tuk-tuk hops** if needed for hills.
- Estimated cost: **€210–€280** total
  - Hotel: €140–€200
  - Food/drinks: €60–€70
  - Transit: €10–€20

### Day 5: LX Factory or Riverside Brunch Before Departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- Morning: Keep the final day flexible with **LX Factory** or a relaxed riverside brunch.
- Afternoon: Last shopping stroll, then head to the airport with plenty of buffer time.
- Dinner: If flying late, do an early farewell seafood lunch instead of a full dinner.
- Transit: Use **metro, taxi, or rideshare** depending on luggage and departure time.
- Estimated cost: **€120–€180** total
  - Food/drinks: €50–€70
  - Transit: €20–€40
  - Miscellaneous/shopping: €50–€70

## Budget Plan for the Full Trip

| Category | Estimated Total | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Hotel | €700–€1,000 | 4 nights in a central, comfortable area |
| Food & drinks | €300–€420 | Mix of cafés, seafood dinners, and snacks |
| Transit | €50–€90 | Metro, tram, train, and a few taxis |
| Entry fees | €120–€220 | Sintra + one or two Lisbon landmarks |
| Buffer / extras | €150–€250 | Coffee, pastries, tips, small purchases |
| Total | **€1,320–€1,980** | Target stays on budget with moderate hotel choice |

## Spring Packing Checklist for Lisbon

- Light jacket or trench coat
- Compact umbrella
- Comfortable walking shoes with grip
- 4–5 breathable tops
- 2 pairs of long pants or jeans
- One nicer outfit for dinner
- Light sweater or cardigan for evenings
- Sunglasses and sunscreen
- Crossbody bag or anti-theft day bag
- Reusable water bottle
- Phone charger and power bank
- Travel documents and copies
- Motion-sickness tablets if you are sensitive to hills, trams, or boats

## Practical Notes for a Relaxed Pace

- Stay in **Baixa, Chiado, or Alfama lower streets** for the easiest sightseeing base.
- Book **one major attraction per day** and leave the rest flexible.
- For the day trip, **Sintra is the best fit** if you want one classic outing without overpacking the schedule.
- Seafood dinners are best enjoyed early; reserve popular places on busy nights.
